newsitem.title: USA: KCBT WHEAT UP IN LATE TRADE ON CWB CROP FORECAST.
newsitem.headline: KCBT WHEAT UP IN LATE TRADE ON CWB CROP FORECAST.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures were higher in late trade, boosted partly by a lower-than-expected forecast of Canadian wheat production issued by the Canadian Wheat Board, dealers said.
The CWB put Western Canadian production at 21.6 million tonnes, down from 29.5 million last year.
"The decrease is attributed to reduced yields and a shift to canola and flaxseed," CWB said in a statement.
Other supportive factors included slightly stronger-than- expected weekly U.S. net export sales of 765,100 tonnes of wheat, above a forecast range of 650,000 to 750,000.
At 1210 CDT September was up 3-1/2 cents a bushel at $3.76-1/2 with other months 5-3/4 to three cents higher.
